title: Polynomial coefficient growth after a fixed linear map
statement: For every natural number n and every complex-linear map T:BinaryForm ℂ n→BinaryForm ℂ n, there exists a real K≥0 such that, for every z∈ℂ and every monomial exponent d, |coeff_d(T((zX+Y)^n))|≤K(1+|z|)^n. The same K works for all z and all d.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (T : ↥(HeckeEis.BinaryForm ℂ n) →ₗ[ℂ] ↥(HeckeEis.BinaryForm ℂ n)), ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ (z : ℂ) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ), ‖MvPolynomial.coeff d (T (HeckeEis.linePow n z)).val‖ ≤ K * (1 + ‖z‖) ^ n
